p1_findings.finding: The TB's capture_mode 1 and capture_mode 2 both execute the M219 module. send_group serializes each set bit into an independent K1 group, so the named K8 snapshot is actually another K1 replay with a different block interleave.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The check validates K1 accumulation order independence, but cannot admit M218-versus-M219 bit equivalence, the 4.952121573x service ratio, or fair K8/K1 performance.
p1_findings.required_followup: Instantiate both exact M218 and M219, feed the same eight-source payload, normalize their request interfaces, and compare result and completion identity before any cross-design admission.

p1_findings.finding: M219 is exercised with a TB response driver that retires the newest outstanding generation. There is no connected L4/II1 eight-bank response recurrence, bank adapter, or frozen-trace cycle replay shared with M218.
p1_findings.scope_effect: No RTL-measured service speedup, physical speedup or complete-FC2 timing result exists. This does not prevent synthesis of the isolated service logic.
p1_findings.required_followup: Use one finite-memory recurrence and the same backpressure policy for M218 and M219; miter request/response/context/result/done counts and report cycles separately.

p1_findings.finding: The directed weight function covers only -15 through +15. Static review confirms correct signed INT8-to-signed25 extension and an Acc24 sign-overflow check, but -128, +127, mixed cancellation and near-overflow/overflow prefixes are not driven.
p1_findings.scope_effect: No arithmetic defect was found, but full numerical corner closure is absent and Formality has not yet checked the mapped logic.
p1_findings.required_followup: Add full-scale signed corners and deliberate Acc24 boundary crossings, then run RTL-to-netlist Formality after DC.

p1_findings.finding: The RTL encodes eight selectable bank identities with a 3-bit bank_id and enforces source_channel modulo-eight ownership, but it instantiates no weight-bank storage, capacity, decoder, 8-to-1 macro output mux or macro timing.
p1_findings.scope_effect: A matched DC can quantify cropped service/control/register logic. It cannot by itself prove equal total memory capacity, fair accelerator area, macro-aware energy or physical banking cost.
p1_findings.required_followup: Keep eight identical external bank macros/capacity in a later A/B adapter and include the K1 bank-select path while preserving the reviewed epoch/slot/generation/bank identity.

p1_findings.finding: Independent VCS with seed 219997 reproduces the exact PASS and all covers, but the TB uses deterministic modulo stalls and deterministic newest-generation retirement. The changed random seed does not alter the schedule.
p1_findings.scope_effect: The suite is strong directed evidence, not constrained-random or formal exhaustive proof.
p1_findings.required_followup: Before protocol closure, add multiple truly randomized legal response/backpressure schedules or formal ownership/exact-once properties under memory fairness assumptions.

p1_findings.finding: Request/result/group/done/flush hold properties pass, and same-edge slot/context reuse is exercised. Header, frontend-done and incoming response stability are not asserted; frontend_done_had_event is forwarded without cross-checking accepted group presence.
p1_findings.scope_effect: No observed corruption exists under the directed producer/memory model, but wrapper-level assumptions remain trusted.
p1_findings.required_followup: Assert source-side stability and had_event consistency in the connected wrapper or document them as explicit interface invariants.

p1_findings.finding: M219 has exact-SHA source-level VCS only. There is no M219 DC/check_design, Formality, PT, SAIF/PTPX, context SRAM macro or routed result.
p1_findings.scope_effect: Opening exact matched service-only DC is appropriate; area, timing and power claims remain false until their respective evidence exists.
p1_findings.required_followup: Run the same 3 ns ideal-clock ZeroWireload logic/register DC flow as M218, publish area composition and hold cost, and do not label it paper PPA.

independent_evidence.clean_conservation: 144 group / 864 request / 864 response / 864 context write / 864 active-bank read / 102 result / 5 done
independent_evidence.coverage: FIFO4, O8, 274 slot reuses, 107 context reuses, 1726 OOO inversion hits, stalls, flush quarantine, four identity attacks, duplicate and timeout all exercised

dc_admission_conditions: Synthesize only the exact-SHA M219 service island at the same 3 ns ideal-clock, ZeroWireload, zero-macro setup used for M218.
Retain O8, FIFO4, 18,432 registered Acc24 context bits, epoch16, generation32 and timeout1024; do not crop those common resources.
Report the 128-bit response skid, context/register composition, I/O count, setup/hold and synthesis warnings explicitly.
Call the result native-cropped K1 service-logic sensitivity only; equal eight-bank capacity remains an external invariant until a common macro adapter exists.
Do not divide any M218 premodel cycle number by the new DC area, and do not admit 4.952x, recurrence, fair energy or complete-FC2/FFN performance from this gate.
